summary: Completed comprehensive testing of standalone booking page (/book) and regression testing of existing modal booking flows. All 38 tests passed (20 backend + 18 frontend). The /book page correctly renders the inline booking widget without modal overlay or close button, bookings are created with UTM attribution, double-booking guard works (409), and all existing modal flows remain functional.
